name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.3): notes only, no change in behaviour. The server's notes now set out how to tick and untick a row on Reconciliation Statements (CA302000) from start to finish (KNOWLEDGE.md section 51): the call, what happens inside it, what Acumatica does to the row and the statement, how to read the result, and what has not been tried. The check made before a write on that screen cites them first. A tick and an untick are proven on build 24.111 and 2026R1, one row at a time; 0.81.2's copy of the notes still called the 24.111 tick unproven. 0.81.2 opened a statement on any cash account, stopped whoami blaming the tenant on a site without DAC-based OData, and let the classic page tools find their page without OData. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
